key_insight: TRACE unifies ACE-style equivariant many-body representations with local multihead cross-attention to learn accurate, energy-conserving interatomic potentials without passing learned state between atoms.
engineering_relevance: It offers a scalable route to train one transferable potential that can model phase behavior, liquids, and reactive events on modest hardware.
method: Builds O(3)-equivariant atomic cluster expansion density correlations for each center
Uses local multihead cross-attention over fixed tensorial neighbor features conditioned on species and geometry
Trains a single energy-conserving potential for crystals, liquids, and gas-phase reactions
evidence_signal: The abstract reports agreement with experiments and reference calculations across cesium lead iodide polymorph ordering and phase transition temperature, water structure, and methyl migration activation free energy.
watch_item: Performance may depend on carefully chosen training data and enhanced sampling for rare-event barriers, so robustness outside the demonstrated chemistries needs validation.
